name: Cross-library field-exchange conservation face (FEM→DEM four ledgers, LBM→FVM remap + interface flux, clock semantics)

failure_faces.description: fracture surface: per facet vertices, outward unit normal, area

element_state.description: convex-polytope element with density, rigid-body velocity/angular velocity, released strain energy

cell_partitions.description: source and target control volumes of the field transfer

clocks.description: dt ratio and coupling sample period

four_ledger.description: mass / linear momentum / angular momentum / energy / full inertia tensor / volume residuals and verdicts

remap_report.description: supermesh mass and momentum inventory residuals, coverage, linear-field exactness

flux_report.description: interface flux residual, area residual, per-target allocation

sync_certificate.description: barrier skew, future-read count, optimistic rollback replay deviation, negative controls

applicability.regime: discrete field exchange between heterogeneous solvers (fracture hand-off, lattice-to-volume interpolation, coupled time stepping)

lbm_fvm_mass_inventory_residual.source: Σ_j ρ_j V_j = Σ_i ρ_i |cell_i ∩ Ω|

lbm_fvm_interface_flux_residual.source: Σ_j ρ_j (u_j·n) A_j = Σ_i ρ_i (u_i·n) A_i on the coupling plane

lbm_fvm_baseline_flux_residual_oblique.source: cell-centre inverse-distance baseline (the error the exact path removes)

sphere_surrogate_inertia_residual.source: sphere-equivalent fragments vs element tensor (structural failure, documented)

sphere_surrogate_angular_momentum_residu.source: sphere-equivalent fragments vs element spin (structural failure, documented)

validation_evidence.relative_error_source: analytic identities with exact geometry: each ledger reference is the source-side integral, so the residual measures bookkeeping plus round-off only
validation_evidence.verification_status_note: 21/21 machine checks pass; the classical baselines miss by 0.85 (inertia tensor), 1.06 (angular momentum) and 7.4e-3 (interface flux), which is exactly what the exact operators remove

failure_modes.symptom: the previous LBM-to-FVM flux check summed rho*u.n over closed cells (identically zero) and read a non-existent density attribute on the FVM cells, so the residual was 0 for every field and the gate could never fail
failure_modes.mitigation: replaced by a mass-inventory identity over the shared domain, plus a negative control test that shifts the target patch and requires a failure

failure_modes.symptom: sphere-equivalent fragments carry (2/5)mr^2*I, so the inertia tensor and the angular-momentum ledgers are structurally unreachable (measured residuals 0.85 and 1.06 on an anisotropic hand-off)
failure_modes.mitigation: fragments are the convex cells produced by the fracture planes and their tensors come from exact tetrahedron moments

failure_modes.symptom: the legacy SyncState rollback rewinds current_time but not the solver state and silently no-ops (returning True) for targets after the checkpoint, leaving current_time != step_count*dt
failure_modes.mitigation: optimistic coupling uses checkpoint + deterministic replay; the defect is measured by audit_legacy_rollback

failure_modes.symptom: a coupling plane that coincides with a cell face is seen by both adjacent cells, so the transferred flux is twice the physical value
failure_modes.mitigation: the planar section is attributed to the upstream cell only

failure_modes.symptom: estimating the section area from dV/dh is exact only away from facet breakpoints and picks up round-off / 2h noise near them
failure_modes.mitigation: the shoelace area of the clipped plane section is authoritative; the level-set route is kept as an independent cross-check with a 1e-5 agreement bound
